name: omarchy-pr-try
description: Inspect, sandbox-test and try Omarchy PRs with verified recovery
author: itscallssh

changes: Three explicit modes: inspection (read only), sandbox testing, live system testing; never switched silently
Privileged work moved to a narrow Python helper (allowlisted paths, O_NOFOLLOW, staged-file checksums, atomic writes, checksummed journal, content-addressed originals); no inline sudo shell
/etc/omarchy.conf is parsed, never sourced
Live application requires a pinned commit, re-checked against GitHub immediately before any change; force-pushes, merges and closures are reported

Bypass variables OMARCHY_PR_ALLOW_HIGH, OMARCHY_PR_ALLOW_NO_SNAPSHOT, OMARCHY_PR_UNSAFE_TEST, OMARCHY_PR_TEST_NET are ignored; scoped exceptions only via ~/.config/omarchy-pr-try/policy.conf (PR@exact-commit, mode 600)
CRITICAL risk level; every finding has file, line, excerpt, why, impact and action; risk --json; shell syntax-tree analysis via shfmt

Sandbox: bubblewrap with every namespace, empty home, cleared environment, no capabilities, time/memory limits, isolation verified from inside before tests run; network only with --net and confirmation
Fixed: a failure while writing user config left system files and earlier config files changed; the whole transaction is now rolled back and verified
Transactions: durable manifest, checkpoint record, archive; idempotent restore with verification; verify-recovery command; orphaned transactions recovered
Preflight: pacman lock, omarchy update lock, free space, bootloader, version compatibility, state permissions
Compatibility engine with categories and Coverage FULL/PARTIAL/NONE; results never claim full coverage when parts were not exercised
New dashboard with the Omarchy mark, theme colours, NO_COLOR, narrow-terminal layouts; GO BACK TO ORIGINAL OMARCHY first while active
MARK AS TESTED / REPORT PROBLEM recorded locally first; comments previewed, secret-checked, never approvals
Terminal-escape and Unicode-control sanitization of all PR and API text; hardened git (https/file only, no hooks)
Test suite: existing assertions kept or tightened, about 200 new assertions over 40 regression scenarios
verify now exits non-zero when a file is not in place or another command hides it
The menu offers Verify active PR when no PR is active, as documented
Long PR titles are truncated and the PR card width is clamped, so narrow terminals no longer break the layout
The PR picker's check legend explains the '?' (unknown) status
try installs the PR's changed files into the real system (/usr/bin, /usr/share/omarchy, ~/.config) so the running session uses them at once
Originals saved in a root-owned folder with checksums; back restores them and leaves files a package update replaced
New plan command; verify checks each file and PATH shadowing
Failed or interrupted installs are rolled back
--link keeps the old dev-link behaviour
Fixed an empty PR banner printed by back after a dev-link
Force-push detection now runs before the risk scan (warns and requires confirmation)
Menu try failures are no longer silently swallowed
New verification block after linking showing PR is active and how to verify it
New verify subcommand and menu item
Explained graphical-session reload requirement in the reboot flow
Install hint when run from an obscure path
Better back output pointing to where downloaded PR code lives
162-test suite passes
